newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - 11 Oct.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - 11 Oct.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
VANDALS TOLD TO CLEAN IT UP

- John Major will announce radical new proposals at the Conservative conference today on the punishment of young criminals. He will propose that those who daub graffiti, break windows, or vandalise cars should be made to help clear up the mess and apologise to the victims.
EASTERN LEGAL THREAT AGAINST WINDFALL TAX
- Eastern Group, the energy arm of the Hanson empire which will soon be demerged, is to mount a legal challenge to Labour's planned windfall tax on the utilities.
VOTE OF CONFIDENCE FROM BIG COMPANIES

- A survey published today by SBC Warbury, finds that 48 percent of business leaders now expect economic conditions to improve over the next 12 months, compared to 30 percent six months ago, and 14 percent a year ago.
